summary: The SGLang-owned MLA writers are already fixed in the prepared source and their ROCm-focused regressions pass, but the current fused AITER GLM writer still overwrites reserved slot 0. The required caller-defined pad_slot_id API is proposed by open, unmerged ROCm/aiter PR #5010, so no compatible SGLang call-site correction can yet be validated with the prepared dependency.

tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, a NaN padding row mapped to slot 0 changed all 576 BF16 elements of the finite sentinel slot to NaN; the independent positive destination slot 1 remained finite. The probe asserts this currently reproduced behavior.

5 ROCm-applicable SGLang-owned MLA writer tests passed and 58 CUDA-only or locally deselected matrix cases skipped; coverage includes int32/int64 BF16 reserved-slot guards, explicit opt-out, FP8 quantized, scale buffer, and valid positive-slot writes.
The required AITER pad_slot_id API change was open and unmerged; the response is retained at reports/j-fbe78461ef43/raw/aiter_pr_5010.json.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-fbe78461ef43/raw/aiter_fused_slot0_probe.log records AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, 576 NaNs in slot 0, and a finite valid slot 1.

remaining_limitations: ROCm/aiter PR #5010 is not merged and the prepared AITER function has no pad_slot_id parameter; the downstream SGLang integration cannot be made and validated compatibly yet.
The reported GLM-5.2-MXFP4 weights were unavailable, so model semantic accuracy and the original real-weight output corruption were not tested.
Only one assigned gfx950 GPU was used; TP8, DP4, EP8, MTP, multi-node, and eight-GPU behavior remain unverified.
CUDA TMA/JIT writer execution was unavailable on AMD hardware; its existing source regression was skipped as designed.
